create_diffusion_policy: create a DiffusionPolicy instance to generate robot arm trajectories conditioned on block and arm state
run_diffusion_policy_predict: run the DiffusionPolicy.predict method to generate a sequence of 16 (x,y) positions for a robot arm
build_observation_encoder: build an ObservationEncoder to convert raw robot observations into a compact 256-dim representation
build_observation_projection: build an ObservationProjection to transform encoded observations into 32 contextual values for the diffusion model
test_diffusion_policy_normalize: test the DiffusionPolicy.normalize_data and unnormalize_data methods for scaling observations and actions
